verdict.rationale: Veriff is an identity-verification SaaS that processes biometric and document data, so whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an AI-training opt-out, data-usage controls or a training policy. The pack only covers sessions, SDKs, webhooks, HMAC security and pricing, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
